introduction: Pennsylvania LIHEAP helps eligible households with heating costs and qualifying heat emergencies. Intake follows seasonal announcements.
description: Pennsylvania LIHEAP helps eligible households with heating costs and qualifying heat emergencies. Intake follows seasonal announcements.

sections.who: Renters and homeowners can qualify under household income rules. You do not need to receive another assistance benefit or already owe an unpaid heating bill.
sections.get: A heating grant is credited to the utility or fuel supplier. Crisis assistance has separate emergency conditions.
sections.docs:
• Household and income information.
  • Heating supplier and account details.
  • Any shutoff, fuel shortage or equipment-emergency evidence.
sections.apply:
1. Check the season

    The state currently schedules 2026–27 intake to open November 2, 2026; confirm the announcement before applying.

  2. Use the current instructions

    Follow the application route on the LIHEAP page or contact your county assistance office.

  3. Explain a crisis

    Ask separately about an urgent heating emergency and required evidence.
sections.after: Track a submitted case at trackmybenefits.pa.gov. Pending assistance is not confirmation that a shutoff is stopped.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using State LIHEAP application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: As checked October 1, the next season is scheduled for November 2.
Must I already owe a bill?
No. An unpaid heating bill is not required for the regular grant.
The regular grant goes to the energy supplier.
